experiment: MEAFLOW-52 causal long/short sleeve diagnostic; no tuning
strategy: 7d funding rank, 7d rebalance, 20% tails; BTC 30d mark return thresholds +/-5%; bull/short policy fixed
data_source: Official free Binance Vision monthly fundingRate and 1h markPriceKlines; ZIP CRC checked; no interpolation.
timestamp_semantics: Regime at decision t uses last fully completed BTC 1h mark candle at t-1h.
drawdown: Hourly adverse mark using simultaneous low for longs/high for shorts plus funding-event equity; OHLC stress, not tick accurate.

method.combined_reference: Bull both directions (50% long/50% short); bear short-only.
method.bull_long_sleeve: Only bull-regime long book; all bear/sideways/unknown periods flat.
method.bear_short_sleeve: Only bear-regime short book; all bull/sideways/unknown periods flat.
method.important: Each sleeve is independently initialized with 100 USDT and uses 100% notional at 1x when active. Sleeve returns are not additive and are not a decomposition of the combined portfolio. They test standalone directional sleeve quality under identical signal ranking and costs.

limitations: Previously inspected calendar periods; sequential diagnostic, not pristine OOS.
Hourly OHLC adverse stress is not tick-level liquidation simulation.
Separate sleeve portfolios have independent 100 USDT equity and full notional; cannot add sleeve returns to recover combined portfolio return.
decision_rule: Diagnostic only. No parameter selection or strategy promotion from this report.
